startServer(){
    local connected=0 fd
    exec {fd}<> <(:)
    nc -q 0 -l -p "$PORT" <&$fd | 
    while read -r line
    do  if [ "$connected" == "0" ]
        then startServer $(($1+1)) &
             connected="1"
        fi
        echo server $1 logic goes here
    done >&$fd
    exec {fd}<&-
}

#!/bin/bash

minipv() {
    sleep=$1
    while read line; do
	echo "$line"
	sleep $sleep
    done
}
export -f minipv

echo '### Test id = --id `tty`'
parallel --id `tty` --lb --semaphore seq  1 10 '|' minipv 0.1
echo '### Test default id = --id `tty`'
parallel            --lb --semaphore seq 11 20 '|' minipv 0.01
echo '### Test --semaphorename `tty`'
parallel --semaphorename `tty` --semaphore --wait
echo done

	echo PARENTS_IDEA_OF_CHILD=$!

test x"$REAL_CHILD" != x"" \
&& test x"$REAL_CHILD" = x"$PARENTS_IDEA_OF_CHILD"
